description: This PHP class defines a Request object for an API, encapsulating HTTP request data such as request method, body parameters, URL attributes, and query parameters within the OrangeHRM HRMS system. It provides methods for accessing and manipulating these parameters, serving as a core component in handling API requests in version 2 of the OrangeHRM Core API.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request in the OrangeHRM API, providing access to request method, body, attributes, and query parameters, encapsulating the underlying HttpRequest object.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Request object by wrapping the provided HttpRequest and extracting its parameters into ParameterBag objects.

methods.name: getHttpRequest
methods.description: Returns the underlying HttpRequest object associated with this API request.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Returns the ParameterBag containing the request body parameters ($_POST).

methods.name: setBody
methods.description: Sets the ParameterBag for the request body parameters.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns the ParameterBag containing URL attributes.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets the ParameterBag for the URL attributes.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Returns the ParameterBag containing query string parameters ($_GET).

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Sets the ParameterBag for the query string parameters.

methods.name: getAllParameters
methods.description: Returns a combined array of all request parameters: body, attributes, and query.
